requests.prompt: Create one corrected orthographic BOTTOM principal view of this exact square wet jungle earth floor tile, isolated on transparent background, same pixel-art style, palette, outline thickness, and scale as the reference views. The bottom image must show the opaque physical substrate underside of the orange-brown earth tile: uninterrupted compact soil and clay base with dark earthen side rim, and only real roots/green plants that genuinely overhang the tile boundary may appear beyond its edge. Do not show any blue puddle, water, stars, reflections, flowers or upper-facing decorations through the opaque earth. Keep a square axis-aligned footprint, straight down-facing underside, no perspective, no extra objects, centered on a 256x256 transparent canvas. The source/approved TOP references define the material and footprint; the current bottom is only a scale/layout guide.
requests.visual_review: One square orange soil/clay underside with dark rim and green roots/leaves overhanging the border; no blue puddles or star reflections. Needs thresholded crop and uniform normalization into common 256-canvas scale for root review.
